invariant_exclusions: two changed function bodies/complete capability-pinned facts
user_blocks table/column ACL and sequence ACL: complete before/after capability pin

functions.defaults: NULL::uuid, NULL::uuid, NULL::text, NULL::timestamp with time zone

views.name: public.discovery_listings_v1
views.definition:
WITH viewer_hidden AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT public.hidden_provider_ids_for_viewer_v1() AS identity_id
        )
 SELECT id,
    created_at,
    title,
    description,
    price,
    image,
    status,
    category,
    condition,
    country,
    city,
    location,
    user_id,
    ai_title,
    ai_description,
    ai_category,
    ai_detected_brand,
    ai_detected_type,
    ai_confidence,
    ai_raw,
    manufacturer,
    part_number,
    oem_number,
    vehicle_brand,
    vehicle_model,
    vehicle_year,
    engine,
    compatibility,
    is_featured,
    featured_until,
    ai_enriched,
    ai_level,
    item_type,
    subcategory,
    details,
    ai_status,
    ai_review_required,
    ai_reviewed_by_user,
    search_text,
    active_until,
    is_boosted,
    boost_until,
    seo_title,
    seo_description,
    description_en,
    ai_detected_object,
    ai_suggested_category,
    ai_suggested_subcategory,
    ai_suggested_title,
    ai_suggested_brand,
    ai_suggested_model,
    ai_suggestion_json,
    price_amount,
    search_vector,
    listing_lat,
    listing_lng,
    listing_language,
    identity_id,
    created_by_user_id,
    updated_by_user_id,
    price_kind,
    currency,
    price_revision
   FROM public.listings l
  WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM viewer_hidden h
          WHERE h.identity_id = l.identity_id)) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM public.user_blocks b
          WHERE auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND (b.blocker_id = auth.uid() AND b.blocked_id = l.user_id OR b.blocked_id = auth.uid() AND b.blocker_id = l.user_id)));

indexes.name: public.user_blocks_blocked_blocker_idx_v1
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX user_blocks_blocked_blocker_idx_v1 ON public.user_blocks USING btree (blocked_id, blocker_id)

indexes.name: public.user_blocks_blocker_id_blocked_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_blocks_blocker_id_blocked_id_key ON public.user_blocks USING btree (blocker_id, blocked_id)

indexes.name: public.user_blocks_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_blocks_pkey ON public.user_blocks USING btree (id)

constraints.name: user_blocks_blocked_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (blocked_id) REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: user_blocks_blocker_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (blocker_id) REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

trigger.name: user_blocks_cas_delete_v1
trigger.definition: CREATE TRIGGER user_blocks_cas_delete_v1 BEFORE DELETE ON public.user_blocks FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION provider_controls_private.guard_account_block_delete_v1()
